Lean conditional bounds and isolation premises
Exact Bazel O1/O3 bootstrap and p11
OPEN: C pointer/root/frame refinement, full-round packing and native failure; commit blocked
Source upper bound may become capacity evidence only after unique scanning and destination packing are proved.
Old collective publishes abort_isolated before healthy GC; detached empty intervals may be reused, stable native identity must not be overwritten.
Disjoint chunk traversal requests do not replace the per-object write claim; copy-winner Tail and special frame links retain separate custody.
A scanner claiming a raw-ready frame must acquire the frame domain before reading the structural link or ordinary roots; constructor writes precede release.
Private grants and known-result refunds provide physical accounting premises; they do not alone establish U, Amax or a pre-flip whole-round grant.
Captured-frame payload construction uses the same contiguous reservation and commit endpoints; frame/link publication does not erase allocation debt.
